name: Nanjing COSMOS Chemical Co., Ltd.
summary: Nanjing COSMOS Chemical Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, production, and sale of raw materials for daily chemical products in China and internationally. The company offers UV filters, washing and cleaning care products, fragrance molecules, and emollients. It also provides cosmetic active ingredients and raw materials, as well as synthetic fragrances, and exports its products. Nanjing COSMOS Chemical Co., Ltd. was founded in 2000 and is headquartered in Nanjing, China.
